name: @pipeworx/mcp-jhtdb

tools.name: jhtdb_datasets
tools.description: Catalog of Johns Hopkins Turbulence Databases (JHTDB) datasets available for point queries — forced isotropic turbulence, channel flow, MHD turbulence, transitional boundary layer, atmospheric boundary layer and wind-farm LES, and more. Each entry gives the dataset code to pass to jhtdb_point_query, its spatial domain (x/y/z ranges, in the dataset's native simulation units), grid resolution, time range, and which physical fields (velocity, pressure, magnetic field, temperature, ...) it carries.

tools.name: jhtdb_point_query
tools.description: Interpolated velocity, pressure, or velocity-gradient values at up to 10 points and a single time in a Johns Hopkins Turbulence Databases (JHTDB) reference DNS/LES dataset. Values are returned in the dataset's native simulation units (dimensionless DNS code units for the isotropic/channel/MHD datasets; physical meters/seconds for the atmospheric-boundary-layer and wind-farm LES datasets) — call jhtdb_datasets first to see a dataset's domain and time range. Uses JHTDB's public testing authorization token, capped well under its documented small-query allowance.

time.description: Simulation time at which to evaluate the field, within the dataset's time range from jhtdb_datasets.

points.description: 1 to 10 points, each {x, y, z} in the dataset's native spatial units.

spatial_interpolation.description: Spatial interpolation kernel. Defaults to Lag4 for velocity/pressure, None_Fd4 (4th-order finite difference, no interpolation) for velocity_gradient.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-jhtdb forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the jhtdb pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
